name: Core page: header, hours, location and warm mobile-first styling
purpose: Site v0 has no Brew Lab header, hours, location or styling.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if the output is not a single HTML file or the retry also fails the completion check.

outputs: index.html with header, hours and location sections and inline CSS
completion_check: Title and header read Brew Lab; hours text says 8am to 10pm every day; location names Indiranagar, Bengaluru with a map link and a visible address placeholder; viewport meta present; base CSS is for small screens with min-width media queries; no horizontal scroll at 375px.

name: Menu section with marked placeholders
purpose: No menu section exists, and no menu items or prices have been supplied.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if any real-looking price or item name appears that the Requester did not supply.

outputs: Menu section and menu data array in index.html
completion_check: The menu section renders at least 4 drink rows, each with a price field, and every unsupplied name or price is visibly marked as a placeholder. No invented real prices appear.

name: Pre-order form with order summary
purpose: Visitors cannot pre-order coffee for pickup.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if any payment field or network send is added, or the retry still accepts a pickup time outside 8am to 10pm.

outputs: Pre-order form and submit handler in index.html
completion_check: The form has item and quantity inputs fed from the menu data, name and phone fields, and a time input limited to 08:00 to 22:00. Submitting a valid order shows a summary with items, quantities, name, phone and pickup time. A time outside 8am to 10pm is rejected. No payment fields exist.
